title: Recording application events from a test's child threads
summary: New child threads now share the recording test's events. In Jupiter the PER_CLASS and CONCURRENT combination was rejected with global parallelism both enabled and disabled.

change.description: The test context shares its event recorder with threads created during the recording test. The JUnit Jupiter extension also rejects a specified combination of recording, concurrent execution and per-class test instances.

notes: An actual EngineTestKit run checks the container error. The event cases create and join both children after the recording test starts.
